title: Map Maker hand-placed world wonders v2
description: Wonders placed by hand on one world (ADR-0097), each with the settings it fixes (ADR-0098). A planet adds them after erosion and climate; random wonders are planet build settings, not part of this document.

kind.description: A wonder kind from the catalog (domain.wonders).

position.description: Source-map coordinates of the wonder (its first end for wonders placed by two ends).

seed.description: The wonder's own random stream: its shape is drawn from this seed and its kind, independent of the planet seed and of other wonders.

size_km.description: What the kind's size measures (diameter, width or height); null uses the usual size and is the only value for kinds without a size.

end.description: The far end of a wonder placed by two ends; null for others.

age_myr.description: Age (Myr) for the aging tool; null uses the wonder settings' age. Only craters, chasms, great cliffs and tepuis age.

options.description: Settings this wonder fixes; the others are left to the generator. Which a kind has, and their ranges, follow the catalog (domain.wonders): titan: height_m; shattered: height_m; active: height_m; crater: depth_m; chasm: depth_m, side_canyons, parallel_troughs; tepui: height_m, elongation, orientation_deg; fork: share_pct.
